translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aar Fenai Rhaepeto Kkewe
Aaemweoi Pharisees me sinsein anniug kkewe re itto me Jerusalem ra mwirhito reen Jesus.
Ra giuneei pwe aaemweoi me neeiir naiun Jesus rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra mwongo wooan paiiur nge e nimaenneew, pwe rese toafi paiiur taeppen minna Pharisees re aengaeniir aeremas pwe repwe feeori.

(Pwe Pharisees me oanongeer Jews, re tapweei rhag miniwe rhaepeto kkewe aar ra aeni fenai ngaeniir: Re fasiun gaen toafi paiiur taeppen wunuunun toatoan pai na iir re fasiun feoffeeori weni mmwaen aar repwe mwongo;

nge rese pwan mwongo minikka e itto me noan imwaen chuwaai igine rese nniuwan mwo. Iwe nge repwan tapweei rhag ssowun anniug kkewe re fasiun aengaeniir, wunuunun aar toafi kkap, raaw, saepiy me gieer.)
Iwe Pharisees me sinsein anniug kkewe ra aeiineow Jesus pwe, “Meeta rhooan kkayeo kkomwu noawumw rese tapweei aar fenai rhaepeto kkewe aarh reen, nge ra faer mwongo wooan paiiur min nimaenneew?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “A gin weneeti meeta we Isaiah a faer fenaiuw pwe wunuunumi. Aaemi rhooa oatupwutupw, taeppen rhag aan foatogi:

content.text: ‘Deus a aepesa pwe: Aeremas kkeei ra oassoamwooniaei rhag reen aar kkepas,
nge nee tipeer a igin taaw saengiaei.
pwe re fenaiuw aar aeremas anniug,
nge ra feeori pwe aetae gaen aaei anniug.’

content: “Aaemi oawwa oatoranoa aaen Deus anniug, nge oawwa tapweei feeoriaen aeremas.”
Nge Jesus a soapwei noa pwe, “Oaw igin angmwamwaai reen aaemi oawpwe arhiuwa noa anniug kkewe aaen Deus minni aaemi oawpwe aemaemaewa kkomi.
Pwe Moses a aepesa pwe, ‘Wopwe aesirowu semoamw me inoamw,’ iwe me, ‘Iyo a oari seman aere inan, nge repwe niiy noa.’
Nge aaemi oawwa aepesa pwe aere erhai a yor reen aekkaew meeta epwe tipaengi ngaeni seman aere inan, nge a aepesa pwe, ‘Minneen nge Corban,’ (faaen minneen nge aaen Deus),
iwe a yor pweniun pwe esoapw tipaengi seman aere inan.
Reen taeppen fenai e oawwa aengaeniir aeremas nge e oamoai noa mwaeniaen Deus. Nge e towunap aegiaeg oawfeeori ikka e ieei wusun.”
Minikka e Aenimaenneewa Aeremas
Iwe Jesus a faingiir to pwuwaen aeremas kkewe nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw aiussaening ngaeniaei oanongaemi, pwe oawpwe metaf.
Esooar meeta minne epwe toonong nee rhiumi nge epwe aenimaenneewagaemi noa. Pwe faer minne etowow me nee rhiumi minne epwe aenimaenneewagaemi.
[Iyo a yor saeningan, epwe rongorong.]
Igiwe a mwet saengi aeremas kkewe a noa toonong nee iimw, iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra tingoar ngaeni pwe epwe aemmetefa ngaeniir faaen kkepas kkewe.
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Iwe aaemi mwo nge oawse metaf pwan taeppen rhag ikkina aaemweoi? Oawse metaf? Esooar minne epwe toonong nee rhiumi nge epwe aenimaenneewagaemi,
pwe ese toonong noan pwunnomi pwe etonong noan upwaemi, mwirin a toowow saengi oanongaemi.” (Reen kkepas een nge Jesus a pwaeritae pwe oanongaen mwongo nge egacch pwe aeremas repwe mwongo.)
Nge a soapwei noa nge aepesa pwe, “Meeta a toowow saengi nee rhiumi minne e aenimaenneewagaemi.
Pwe saengi nee rhiumi me pwunnomi, a toowow niunniuwaen aenneew, feoffeeor aenneew fetaen, mwoarho, nni menaw,
maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai, rhegoaw me towunepaen min aenneew, oatupwutupw, mwechenia, noanowo, kkepas aenneew, oangonongon me tipoarorh.
Oanongan feoffeeor kkeei nge etowow saengi nee rhiumi a itiwow aenimaenneewagaemi.”
Aaen Erhai Rhooapwut Niugiuniug
Iwe Jesus a noa saengi igiwe a noa eew pwiuneoi e arap ngaeni aepinoamwon Tyre. A toonong noan eew iimw nge ese tipaeni pwe erhai epwe giuneei pwe a no igiwe, nge ese mmwenen wop ssiunaei igiwe.
Iwe nge erhai rhooapwut eyor naiun aeterhooapwut ewartae aniu aenneew wooan, a rongorong wunuunun Jesus nge a itto reen nge a itto foatotiw oaron pirheen.

Rhooapwut een nge erhai rhooapwuton Gentile, a wupwutiw noan faniuwaen Phoenicia iwe noan Syria. A tingoar aeffaenipirhe ngaeni Jesus pwe epwe asiuw wow aniu aenneew we me reen aeterhooapwut we naiun.
Nge Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Sipwe mmwaen oamwongoor wonigaet. Ese mwamwaai pwe sipwe pwigi aeneer wonigaet mwongo nge sa oatora ngaeniir gonaag.”
Rhooapwut we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Menap, gonaag mwo nge re mwongo peipeyin aeneer wonigaet me faaen table.”
Iwe Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Pwonno reen minimwu mwaenioamw, wone sefaaen noa nee iimw, pwe e aniu aenneew we a toowow me reen aeterhooapwut we noawumw.”
Iwe rhooapwut we a noa nee iimw nge a noa weri aetewe naiun pwe ewon noan gien, nge ennetaen pwe aniu aenneew we a siunoa me wooan.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Niparh Ewan me Saeningan
Jesus a noa saengi faniuwaen Tyre a noa ngaeni Sidon toori meoneoiniuniun Galilee, nge a mwet nong noan faniuwaen Decapolis.
Aaemweoi aeremas ra noa pwigito reen Jesus erhai mwaaen e saeningapiung nge egin waeiraes epwe kkepas, nge ra aeffaenipirhe ngaeni Jesus pwe epwe iseni tae paiun wooan.
Iwe Jesus a paeninoa mwaaen we saengiir aeremas kkewe, a tugunong noan saeningaen mwaaen we, nge a oattuffa, nge a geotteopa rheoniuwan.
Mwirin Jesus a fattae naaeng, a nngas faeregit noa, nge a aengaeni mwaaen we pwe, “Ephphatha!” faaen nge “Sugaeg tae!”
Iwe rhag nge mwaaen we a mmwen epwene rongorong, a saenetaeg noa rheon ngaerhen, nge a rhaepetae aan kkepas.
Iwe Jesus a anniugiu ngaeniir aeremas kkewe pwe resoapw fioangei ngaeni mwo nge erhai; nge nepaen aan anniugiu ngaeniir, nge nepaen aar noa aepesa fetaeneei.

Oanongeer rhooawe re rongorong kkepas we ra gin mwaar. Ra aepesa pwe, “A igin mwamwaai oanongaen minikka a feeori. Epwan feeori mwo nge rhooa piung repwene rongorong, me rhooa parh eweri repwene kkepas.”

footnotes.text: Petenan eei nge e soano noan aekkaew petenan kka e foatofoat noan kkepesaen Greek.
